user.title: AH Laatste Kans
user.description: Choose the country of your Albert Heijn account.

login.title: Log in to Albert Heijn
login.description:
You log in on **AH's own page**, with your password and the 6-digit code. Home Assistant never sees your password.

**With the Mac app (recommended):**
1. In the app, choose **Kansjes › Code voor Home Assistant…**
2. Log in and enter the 6 digits. The code is then on your clipboard.
3. Paste it below and submit **right away**: the code expires quickly.

**Without the Mac app** (may not work: AH's verification step sometimes refuses regular browsers): open the developer tools (F12) on the Console tab, log in via the [AH login page]({login_url}) and copy the `appie://login-exit?code=…` line from the console.
